subsections.title: Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Using Machine Learning
content: Built a machine-learning pipeline to detect diabetic retinopathy from retinal fundus images using a publicly available dataset of labeled retinal images.
Performed data preprocessing, model training, and evaluation using Python and computer-vision libraries, focusing on identifying visual patterns associated with diabetic retinopathy.
Presented the system at the Advanced Innovation Global Competition in Singapore, receiving a Gold Medal.

subsections.title: Application of Machine Learning Algorithms in Prediction of Hotel Booking Cancellations
content: Published research in IJSRM (International Journal of Scientific Research and Management), September 2025, evaluating five ML algorithms: Random Forest, k-Nearest Neighbors, Naive Bayes, SVM, and Decision Tree to predict hotel booking cancellations.

Trained and tested models on 36,300 customer records (25,000 training, 11,300 testing) using 13 booking features including lead time, average price per room, meal plan type, and prior cancellation history.
Random Forest achieved the highest classification accuracy at 91.0%, outperforming k-NN (82.5%), Naive Bayes (82.0%), SVM (80.0%), and Decision Tree (79.0%).

subsections.title: AI-Activated Robotic Arm
content: Developed the AI and programming components of a computer-vision-driven robotic arm, using an object-detection model to trigger physical arm movements based on detection results.
Trained an object-detection model using the Ultralytics YOLO framework and wrote integration code connecting model predictions to robotic-arm behavior.
Presented the system at the World Invention Creativity Olympic and Conference in Korea, receiving a Gold Medal.

subsections.title: ECO SMART RAIL TRANSIT: AI-Based Railway Safety Monitoring System
content: Built a computer-vision system for automated railway safety monitoring, training an object-detection model to identify potential hazards in railway environments.
Managed the full ML pipeline: data preparation, model training using the Ultralytics YOLO ecosystem, and evaluation on held-out images; used cloud-based computing for model training.
Presented the system at INOVA 2025 (49th International Invention Show) in Croatia, receiving a Gold Medal.
